Question: What are the top 5 product categories by number of items sold in delivered orders? Use English category names.
text:
```sql
SELECT 
    pct.product_category_name_english AS category,
    COUNT(*) AS items_sold
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN product_category_name_translation pct 
    ON p.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
GROUP BY pct.product_category_name_english
ORDER BY items_sold DESC
LIMIT 5;
```
This query counts how many order‑item rows (i.e., items sold) each product category has in orders marked as delivered, then returns the top five categories using their English names.
